# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi

"""Bounded first actual phase model lifecycle, diagnostics only, never speed evidence."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import importlib.util
import json
import re
import time

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/feat-layer-major-phase4k-20261013')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('phase_model_lifetime_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.sha(O) == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'


def load(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    prerequisites = [B / name / 'record.json' for name in (
        'main-layer-major-phase4k-full-build-root-v1', 'main-layer-major-phase4k-full-lints-root-v2',
        'main-layer-major-phase4k-full-lease-tiny-root-v1', 'main-layer-major-phase-prefix16k-first-row-root-v1',
        'main-phase-gated-quality-publication-root-v3')]
    proofs = [load(path) for path in prerequisites]
    assert all(p['passed'] and p['complete'] and not p['active'] for p in proofs)
    assert all(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] for p in proofs for c in p['commands'])
    build, lint, tiny = proofs[:3]
    assert lint['lints_qualified'] and tiny['actual_tiny_vmm_qualified'] and tiny['actual_full_physical_lease_qualified']
    assert all(tiny['cases'][mode]['binary_sha256'] == build[mode]['vmm_fixture_sha256'] for mode in ('free','contrib-llvm'))
    for name, sha in build['source_pins'].items():
        if not name.startswith('docs/'):
            assert m.sha(W / name) == sha
    out = B / 'main-layer-major-phase4k-prefix32k-first-row-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    seed = load(B / 'main-upstream-benchsh-seed-root-v2/record.json')
    cfg = load(B / 'main-upstream-benchsh-quiet-copy0-launch-root-v1/server-quiet.json')
    capture_dir = out / 'captures'
    capture_dir.mkdir()
    env = dict(cfg['env'], STRATA_PHASE_DECODE_CACHE='1', STRATA_PHASE_HEAD_LEASE='1', STRATA_PREFILL_LAYER_MAJOR='1', STRATA_PREFILL_LAYER_MAJOR_R_GPU='32768', STRATA_SERVE_FIRST_ROW_CAPTURE='1', STRATA_SERVE_FIRST_ROW_DIR=str(capture_dir),
               STRATA_PREFILL_SCRATCH_ALIAS='1', STRATA_PHASE_PREFILL_12K='0', STRATA_PREFILL_GATED_ALIAS='1', STRATA_TRACE='1',
               ZE_ENABLE_VALIDATION_LAYER='1', ZE_ENABLE_PARAMETER_VALIDATION='1')
    utility = dict(PATH='/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi', LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8',
                   XDG_RUNTIME_DIR='/run/user/1000', PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1')
    binary = W / 'build/free/strata'
    assert m.sha(binary) == build['free']['binary_sha256']
    argv = list(seed['derived_settings']['quiet']['engine_argv'])
    assert argv[0] == cfg['exe'] and argv[1] == '--serve'
    argv[0] = str(binary)
    assert '--vram-reserve-mib' not in argv
    argv += ['--pipeline-windows', '0', '--vram-reserve-mib', '700']
    assert argv[argv.index('--prefill') + 1] == '8192'
    argv[argv.index('--prefill') + 1] = '4096'
    assert argv[argv.index('--vram-reserve-mib')+1] == '700'
    model_path = B / 'latest-update-main-model-identity-v1.json'
    model = load(model_path)
    assert model['passed'] and model['complete'] and not model['active'] and model['full_hashes_verified']
    fixture = B / 'clean64k-task-fixture-root-r3/coding-review-65536-tokens.txt'
    assert m.sha(fixture) == '5284d8fa53d1ef28f6ba916a629faf901c890bc0c669bf986ee04ed72aa2c3ff'
    ids = [int(item) for item in fixture.read_text().split()]
    assert len(ids) == 65536 and all(0 <= value < 248320 for value in ids)
    packets = []
    for count in (1024, 32768):
        payload = ('GEN 1 temperature=0 ' + ' '.join(map(str, ids[:count])) + '\n').encode()
        import hashlib
        packets.append(dict(prompt_tokens=count, max_new=1, packet_sha256=hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),
                            checkpoint_key_omitted=True, payload=payload))
    providers = dict(tiny['provider_hashes'])
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, main_reviewed=True, commands=[], evidence={},
        environment=env, engine_argv=argv, source_revision='8b48d17c99b70d32781f9f5b056602a598a37b1c',
        source_pins={name: m.sha(W / name) for name in build['source_pins']},
        controller_sha256=m.sha(__file__), binary_sha256=m.sha(binary), provider_hashes=providers,
        source_uncommitted_candidate=True, source_changes_only_eighteen_qualified_files=True, previous_goal_turn_classification="progress: actual8K head/alias lifetime pass and reviewed12K second-request guard refusal with healthy GPU closure; gated alias full builds/CPU qualification",
        full_decode_cache_physical_lease=1, head_lease=1, scratch_alias=1, gated_alias=1, layer_major=1, layer_major_requested_gpu_rows=32768, configured_prefill_capacity=4096, effective_pipeline_windows=0,
        boot_id=Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip(),
        qualification_receipts={str(path): m.sha(path) for path in prerequisites},
        model_identity_receipt=dict(path=str(model_path), sha256=m.sha(model_path)),
        fixture=dict(path=str(fixture), sha256=m.sha(fixture), total_tokens=len(ids)),
        requests=[{k: v for k, v in packet.items() if k != 'payload'} for packet in packets],
        gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False, quality_qualified=False,
        full_physical262144_qualified=False, performance_eligible=False, performance_samples=[],
        reset_executed=False, service_changes=False, adopted=False,
        scope='Layermajor full decode-cache/head phase lease actual fresh1024/32768 GEN1, private512cache and prefix32768/actual32K allGPU, explicit700MiBreserve,4Kscratch/gatedalias, full248320 FP32row captures. Actualtinyfullphysicallease prerequisite; no speed/quality/256K/adoption claim.',
        raw_log_budget_bytes=64 << 20, next_step='Actual layermajor ordinaryserve/streamed lifecycle and capacity; then phase/head/privatecache integration and numerical/full256K qualification; speedonly unchanged upstreambench.sh')

    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands

    def run(label, argv, selected_env=utility, interaction=None, wall=120, cpu=1200, rss=2 << 30):
        print('OWNED PHASE MODEL CHECK ' + label, flush=True)
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, selected_env, W, interaction=interaction,
            wall=wall, cpu=cpu, rss_cap=rss, text_cap=32 << 20, total_cap=64 << 20)
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        expected = 1 if label == 'engine-phase-lifetime' and r.get('admission_rejected') else 0
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == expected, label
        return so.read_text(), se.read_text(), c

    fault = re.compile(r'page fault|fault response|timestamp stuck|wedg|engine reset|gt reset|'
        r'guc.*(?:timeout|timed out|failed)|device.*lost|Timed out wait for G2H|Check job timeout|'
        r'Timedout job|Schedule disable failed|trying reset|\breset (?:queued|started|done)\b', re.I)

    assert fault.search('reset queued') and fault.search('engine reset')

    def kernel(label):
        stdout, _, _ = run(label, ['/usr/bin/journalctl', '-k', '--after-cursor', r['kernel_cursor'], '--no-pager', '-o', 'json'])
        rows = [json.loads(line) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
        failures = [row for row in rows if fault.search(str(row.get('MESSAGE', '')))]
        r.setdefault('kernel_checks', {})[label] = dict(filter=fault.pattern, total_rows=len(rows), fault_entries=failures,
            relevant_entries=[row for row in rows if re.search(r'\bxe\b|0000:05:00.0|drm|guc', str(row.get('MESSAGE', '')), re.I)],
            dump_present=Path('/sys/bus/pci/devices/0000:05:00.0/devcoredump/data').exists())
        save()
        assert not failures and not r['kernel_checks'][label]['dump_present']

    def health(label):
        health = B / 'xe-source-llvm-small-health-root-v3/health'
        assert m.sha(health) == '3ce3e127898ff1e800b51a24a0369fc5b4a64e864320eed83c9cf21719b1bbe3'
        r['gpu_executed'] = True
        save()
        stdout, _, _ = run(label, [str(health), '0000:05:00.0'], env)
        assert 'PASS 0000:05:00.0: 1 round, 16384 exact words' in stdout.splitlines()
        actual = {line.removeprefix('LIBRARY ') for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith('LIBRARY ')}
        assert actual == set(providers)

    def model_hashes(label):
        entries = model['model_inputs']
        stdout, _, _ = run(label, ['/usr/bin/sha256sum', *[entry['path'] for entry in entries]], wall=600, cpu=1800)
        actual = dict((line[66:], line[:64]) for line in stdout.splitlines())
        assert len(actual) == len(entries)
        assert all(actual[entry['path']] == entry['sha256'] for entry in entries)
        r[label] = dict(complete=True, files=actual)
        save()

    def protocol(io, command):
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 420
        while True:
            line = io.line(max(1, deadline - time.monotonic()))
            assert not line.startswith(('ERR ', 'FATAL ')), line
            if line.startswith('READY '):
                assert line == 'READY 262144 stop'
                r['ready'] = dict(line=line, pid=command['pid'], start_ticks=command['direct_identity']['start_ticks'])
                break
            assert time.monotonic() < deadline, 'finite READY deadline'
        identity = m.identity(command['pid'])
        assert identity and identity['start_ticks'] == command['direct_identity']['start_ticks']
        maps = Path(f"/proc/{command['pid']}/maps").read_text()
        paths = {line.split()[-1] for line in maps.splitlines() if line.split()}
        assert set(providers) <= paths
        r['ready_provider_paths'] = sorted(set(providers) & paths)
        actual_env = dict(item.split('=', 1) for item in Path(f"/proc/{command['pid']}/environ").read_bytes().decode().split('\0') if item)
        assert actual_env == env
        save()
        for index, packet in enumerate(packets):
            print('PHASE LIFETIME GEN ' + str(packet['prompt_tokens']) + ' (not speed evidence)', flush=True)
            io.send(packet['payload'])
            output_ids = []
            end = time.monotonic() + 480
            while True:
                line = io.line(max(1, end - time.monotonic()))
                if line == 'FATAL phase-cache prompt read failed after fresh GEN lease: layer-major: fresh VRAM/RAM bridge + layer-cache + explicit reserve admission failed':
                    r['admission_rejected'] = True
                    r['requests'][index].update(complete=False, admission_rejected=True, reason=line)
                    r['normal_quit'] = dict(original_command=None, written=False, fallback_signals=[], expected_exit=1, source_checked_failstop=True, native_owners_retained_until_process_teardown=True)
                    save()
                    io.proc.stdin.close()
                    io.exit(120)
                    return
                assert not line.startswith(('ERR ', 'FATAL ')), line
                if line.startswith('T '):
                    token = int(line[2:]); assert 0 <= token < 248320
                    output_ids.append(token)
                if line.startswith('DONE '):
                    columns = line.split()
                    valid = len(columns) == 16
                    if valid:
                        generated = int(columns[1])
                        valid = (1 <= generated <= packet['max_new'] and generated == len(output_ids) and
                                 int(columns[2]) == packet['prompt_tokens'] and
                                 columns[5] in ('stop', 'length') and
                                 (columns[5] != 'length' or generated == packet['max_new']) and
                                 int(columns[6]) == int(columns[7]) == int(columns[8]) == 0 and
                                 int(columns[14]) == packet['prompt_tokens'])
                    r['requests'][index].update(complete=valid, done_line=line, output_ids=output_ids,
                        diagnostic_engine_timings_only=True, performance_eligible=False)
                    if not valid:
                        r.setdefault('request_contract_errors', []).append(dict(index=index, line=line))
                    save()
                    break
                assert time.monotonic() < end, 'finite GEN deadline'
            if r.get('request_contract_errors'):
                break
        io.send(b'QUIT\n')
        io.proc.stdin.close()
        r['normal_quit'] = dict(original_command='QUIT', written=True, pipe_closed_after_write=True, fallback_signals=[])
        save()
        io.exit(120)

    try:
        stdout, _, _ = run('source-head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
        assert stdout.strip() == r['source_revision']
        stdout, _, _ = run('source-status', ['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        dirty = {line[3:] for line in stdout.splitlines() if line}
        assert dirty == set(build['source_pins']), dirty
        available = int(next(line.split()[1] for line in Path('/proc/meminfo').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('MemAvailable:'))) * 1024
        r['host_available_bytes'] = available
        assert available >= 80 << 30
        stdout, _, _ = run('embedding-state', ['/usr/bin/systemctl', '--user', 'show', 'llama-server-qwen3embed.service', '-p', 'ActiveState'])
        assert stdout.strip() == 'ActiveState=inactive'
        stdout, _, _ = run('kernel-cursor', ['/usr/bin/journalctl', '-k', '-n', '0', '--show-cursor', '--no-pager'])
        r['kernel_cursor'] = re.search(r'-- cursor: (\S+)', stdout).group(1)
        kernel('kernel-before')
        assert all(m.sha(path) == sha for path, sha in providers.items())
        model_hashes('model-hashes-before')
        health('health-before')
        kernel('kernel-after-prehealth')
        r['model_executed'] = True
        save()
        stdout, stderr, command = run('engine-phase-lifetime', argv, env, protocol, wall=1200, cpu=12000, rss=104 << 30)
        admitted = re.findall(r'strata layer-major: ADMITTED ([^\n]+)',stderr)
        layers = re.findall(r'strata layer-major: layer=(\d+) role=expert-layer-reuse slots=(\d+) uploaded_bytes=(\d+) computed_chunks=(\d+) gpu_rows=(\d+) host_rows=(\d+) completion=checked',stderr)
        r['actual_admissions'] = admitted
        r['actual_layer_rows'] = layers
        assert not re.search(r'ZE_RESULT_ERROR|\bERROR\b',stderr)
        if r.get('admission_rejected'):
            rejected = [i for i,row in enumerate(r['requests']) if row.get('admission_rejected')]
            assert len(rejected) == 1
            at = rejected[0]
            assert all(row.get('complete') for row in r['requests'][:at])
            assert len(admitted) == at and len(layers) == at*48
            r['normal_quit'].update(engine_exit=1,reaped=True,session_empty=True)
            r['phase_guard_failure_scope'] = 'Combined freshVRAM/RAM+query guard; no failed-admission free-byte ledger in this source, so do not attribute solelytoVRAM'
        else:
            assert all(row.get('complete') for row in r['requests']) and not r.get('request_contract_errors')
            assert len(admitted) == 2 and len(layers) == 96
            for index,count in enumerate((1023,32767)):
                group=layers[index*48:(index+1)*48]
                assert [int(row[0]) for row in group] == list(range(48))
                expected_gpu=min(count,32768)
                assert all(int(row[1])==512 and int(row[4])==expected_gpu and int(row[5])==count-expected_gpu for row in group)
                assert all(int(row[3])==(count+4095)//4096 for row in group)
            r['normal_quit'].update(engine_exit=0,reaped=True,session_empty=True)
            r['admission_rejected'] = False
            assert 'strata phase-cache: normal_QUIT owner_closed requests=2' in stderr
            assert stderr.count('strata head-lease: reloaded ') == 2
            assert stderr.count('strata phase-cache: fresh_GEN workspace_reinitialized capacity=4096') == 2
            copied = re.findall(r'strata serve-first-row: COPIED request=(\d+) prompt_P=(\d+) predicted_position=(\d+) source_row=0 effective_T=(\d+) actual_reuse=(\d+) complete=0', stderr)
            completed = re.findall(r'strata serve-first-row: COMPLETE request=(\d+) prompt_P=(\d+) predicted_position=(\d+) source_row=0 actual_reuse=0 vocab=(\d+) bytes=(\d+) file=([^\n]+) diagnostic_only=1', stderr)
            assert copied == [('1','1024','1023','1','0'), ('2','32768','32767','1','0')], copied
            assert len(completed) == len(packets) == 2
            import math, struct
            r['captures'] = []
            for index, row in enumerate(completed, 1):
                request, prompt, position, vocab, byte_count, filename = row
                final = capture_dir / f'request-{index}.bin'
                partial = capture_dir / f'request-{index}.partial'
                assert request == str(index) and int(prompt) == packets[index-1]['prompt_tokens']
                assert int(position) == int(prompt)-1 and filename == str(final)
                assert int(vocab) == 248320 and int(byte_count) == 8+248320*4
                raw = final.read_bytes()
                assert len(raw) == int(byte_count) and struct.unpack_from('<ii',raw) == (248320,1)
                values = struct.unpack_from('<248320f',raw,8)
                assert all(math.isfinite(value) for value in values)
                assert final.stat().st_ino == partial.stat().st_ino and m.sha(final) == m.sha(partial)
                argmax = max(range(len(values)),key=values.__getitem__)
                assert r['requests'][index-1]['output_ids'] == [argmax]
                r['captures'].append(dict(path=str(final), sha256=m.sha(final),bytes=len(raw),shape=[1,248320],dtype='IEEE754FP32LE',
                    prompt_tokens=int(prompt),predicted_position=int(position),argmax=argmax,finite=True,
                    consumer='Main actualserve first-row producer qualification and fixed-history comparator integration',
                    byte_budget=2<<20,next_review='After actual producer integration/paired comparison, retain only required reference rows'))
            assert set(p.name for p in capture_dir.iterdir()) == {'request-1.bin','request-1.partial','request-2.bin','request-2.partial'}
            r['capture_copied_rows'] = copied
            r['capture_completed_rows'] = completed
            r['actual_first_row_capture_qualified'] = True
            r['full_vocabulary_capture'] = True
            r['actual_gated_layouts'] = re.findall(r'strata prefill gated alias: ([^\n]+)',stderr)
            assert len(r['actual_gated_layouts']) == 2 and all('enabled=1' in row and 'pointer_equal=1' in row for row in r['actual_gated_layouts'])
            r['normal_quit'].update(engine_exit=0,owner_closed=True,reaped=True,session_empty=True)
        r['full_phase_private_cache_lifetime_exercised'] = bool(admitted)
        r['prompt_diagnostic_spans'] = re.findall(r'strata phase-cache: prompt_stats ([^\n]+)', stderr)
        r['capacity_diagnostics'] = re.findall(r'strata phase-capacity: ([^\n]+)', stderr)
        r['expert_span_scope'] = 'ms_experts_host includes source fetch and checked copies, not purePCIe; no GEN speed comparison'
        kernel('kernel-after-model')
        health('health-after')
        kernel('kernel-posthealth')
        model_hashes('model-hashes-after')
        assert all(m.sha(W / name) == sha for name, sha in r['source_pins'].items())
        assert all(m.sha(path) == sha for path, sha in providers.items())
        assert Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip() == r['boot_id']
        r.update(passed=not r.get('admission_rejected'), complete=True, phase_engine_lifetime_qualified=not r.get('admission_rejected'),
                 capacity_admitted=not r.get('admission_rejected'), expected_guard_rejection=bool(r.get('admission_rejected')),
                 model_quality_qualified=False, stock_benchmark_executed=False)
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
        if owner.active is None and r.get('kernel_cursor'):
            try:
                kernel('kernel-final-after-failure')
            except BaseException as fault_error:
                r['final_fault_error'] = repr(fault_error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({key: r.get(key) for key in ('passed', 'error', 'phase_engine_lifetime_qualified', 'model_executed')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['complete'] and not r.get('error') else 1)
